nodes.name: 01-marketplace-fe.md
nodes.summary: Recon document analyzing the current state of the Marketplace front-end (MarketplaceApp.tsx, CapabilityRequestCard.tsx) and cataloguing the exact delta vs the warm-Hive Screen-09 Variation A/B design contracts, including integration points, risks, and open questions for PR4.

nodes.name: 02-marketplace-backend.md
nodes.summary: Recon document mapping the existing marketplace backend routes, DB schema (installations table, marketplace.db seed), installer flow, and the three install-state stores (marketplace packages, MCP runtime, connectors/vault), identifying the integration points a PR4 sync store must hook into.

nodes.name: 03-install-state-sync.md
nodes.summary: Deep-dive recon on the shared install-state synchronisation problem for PR4, covering where install state lives per type (skills/connectors/MCP/marketplace), the FE store shape needed for cross-view reactivity, server aggregate gaps, and the concrete deltas vs the Screen-09 contract.

nodes.name: 04-inline-in-chat.md
nodes.summary: Recon document for PR4 Variation B (inline-in-chat install), mapping the full end-to-end chat turn (SSE protocol, block model, useChat reducer, approval card), the install/connect/vault paths each capability type requires, the delta vs the Screen-09 contract, and exact integration points.

nodes.name: 05-agent-pick-search.md
nodes.summary: Recon document for PR4's agent-search/agent-pick feature, covering the searchCapabilities() brain, the acquire_capability tool invocation, the recommend path, the capability router, and the gaps vs the Screen-09 contract along with required integration points.

nodes.name: GROUNDING-2026-06-16.md
nodes.summary: Grounding verification document confirming which PR4 recon contracts are accurate against live code as of 2026-06-16, documenting two material drifts (CapabilityRequestCard binding for Phase D, missing connector/mcp lane in searchCapabilities) and locking verified contracts for each build phase.
